text: 政策利率换锚后，债市、信贷定价将迎哪些变化？ 短期之内LPR大概率保持稳定。商业银行传统贷款定价逻辑则必须随之升级。
text_en: After the policy rate anchor shift, what changes lie ahead for bond market and credit pricing? LPR is likely to remain stable in the short term. The traditional loan pricing logic of commercial banks must be upgraded accordingly.
